responsibility: Exports the low-level PPU intrinsic API for Cell/B.E. and general PowerPC compilation. It defines a broad set of inline or macro wrappers around PowerPC instructions and builtins for bit operations, barriers, SPR/time-base access, cache control, load-reserve/store-conditional atomics, byte-reverse accesses, floating-point arithmetic and conversions, and rotate/mask operations, serving as the programmer-facing instruction-level intrinsic header for the PPU side of the architecture.
